title: 100 lbs (45 kg) cheat hammer curls for 3
summary: Clip of 100 lb (45 kg) cheat hammer curls for 3 reps, set to music. In the description he says he curls the hammer toward the inside of the body, which shortens the moment arm, is easier on the rotator cuff and seems to hit the brachialis more.

claims.claim: He does hammer curls toward the inside of his body: the reduced moment arm makes the lift easier, it is easier on the rotator cuffs, and it seems to involve more brachialis.

exercises.name: Cheat hammer curl (curled toward the inside of the body)
exercises.why: shorter moment arm, easier on rotator cuffs, more brachialis

training_log.notes: dumbbell, curled toward the inside of the body
